Issue Description: Uses unbounded sprintf with fixed-size stack buffers which can trigger unsafe-format findings and risk accidental overflow if formatting changes.
Suggested Fix: Use std::snprintf with explicit buffer size checks and handle formatting failures.
Resolution Status and Notes: Resolved - Replaced all listed sprintf usages with bounded std::snprintf and guarded failure paths.

Issue Description: Success/failure condition is inverted so parent-device fields are only populated on failure while success is logged as failure.
Suggested Fix: Flip the condition to execute parent info population only when status is Core::ERROR_NONE.
Resolution Status and Notes: Resolved - Corrected condition to Core::ERROR_NONE == status and retained failure logging in else path.
